resources.string: User-controlled automation that finds configured visible text (\"Like video\", \"Skip\", \"Loading\") on the current screen and performs taps and app-switch actions on behalf of the device owner. It only acts while explicitly started from the app and stops immediately when Stop is pressed.
⚡ Like video always takes priority over Skip
Accessibility permission is required for user-controlled automation. Use only on screens and apps you are authorized to automate.
Accessibility service is disabled. Enable it, then press Start.
